summary: Backend-only re-test of the 5 fixes from iteration_2. Added /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py (16 tests) and corrected the now-stale expectations in test_razorpay_payments.py + test_auth_and_checkers.py. Full suite: 47 collected, 46 passed, 1 skipped (Winston credits exhausted upstream), 0 failed. CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) POST /api/webhook/razorpay fails closed with 503 'Webhook secret not configured on server' for unsigned AND self-signed bodies, for payment.captured / order.paid / payment.failed / unknown-order; the demo user stayed plan=free with limit 5 and the tx stayed payment_status=pending (previous free-upgrade exploit is dead). (2) _upgrade_user_for_order re-verifies with rzp.order.fetch: a locally VALID HMAC signature over `order|payment` on an order whose Razorpay status is 'created' now returns 200 but payment_status!=paid and the user stays free (limit 5); the /payments/status poll on an unpaid order likewise does not upgrade. (3) GET /api/payments/status/{order_id}: 401 without Authorization, 401 with a garbage bearer token, 404 with a DIFFERENT user's JWT (ownership), 200 with the owner's JWT returning exactly {order_id,status,payment_status,plan_id}, 404 for an unknown order. (4) Plan expiry: with plan_valid_until in the past, /api/auth/me returns usage.plan=free / limit=5 and the downgrade is persisted in Mongo; a future plan_valid_until keeps business with limit -1; expired enterprise is capped at 5. (5) stripe removed from requirements.txt and server.py; Dashboard.jsx contains no 'Stripe' and says 'Razorpay-billed plan, past invoices and payment methods'. Regression: auth (signup/login/me/401), image + qr + url checkers, free 5-then-402 quota all still pass; /api/check/text skipped (Winston INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT, upstream). Frontend UI not re-tested (testing_type: backend only).

minor.issue: STILL OPEN from iteration_2: Winston 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (<300 chars) and 402 INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT are both re-raised as HTTPException(502) (server.py:326-327). The k8s ingress replaces 502 with its own HTML 'Bad gateway' page so the SPA never sees the JSON detail. Map to 400/422 for validation and 503 for credit/outage, and enforce min 300 chars on TextCheckIn.
STILL OPEN: CheckoutIn.origin_url is required but unused in the Razorpay Orders flow (Stripe leftover). Make Optional or drop.
On expiry it sets plan='free' but leaves the stale plan_valid_until on the user doc; harmless today but confusing. Consider $unset plan_valid_until (or keep an expired_at field) on downgrade.

Still calls rzp.order.fetch on every poll with no caching/throttle; now auth+ownership-gated so only the owner can trigger it, but the frontend polls in a loop -> avoidable Razorpay API load. Consider a short-lived cache or stopping the poll once terminal.

action_items: No security regressions left to fix for this iteration - all 5 reported issues verified fixed.

Before go-live: set RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET in backend/.env, then re-run a real signed-webhook test (the handler currently 503s by design, so gateway retries will pile up until the secret is configured).
Map Winston 400/402 to 400/422/503 instead of 502 (ingress hides 502 JSON) and add a 300-char min-length on text/url checks.
server.py is now 720 lines (>700 guideline) - split payments/auth/checkers into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: _upgrade_user_for_order now correctly fails closed: if rzp is None or order.fetch raises, it returns the tx unchanged and grants nothing - good. Consider logging an alert when a signature-verified payment cannot be confirmed with Razorpay, so real paid orders that fail the fetch are not silently left un-upgraded (user paid, plan not granted -> support case). A retry/reconciliation job would close that gap.
Webhook 503 is the right safe default but Razorpay will retry and eventually disable the endpoint; document/monitor this until the secret is set.
get_usage() is now the single enforcement point for plan expiry and is also used by check_and_increment, so quota enforcement inherits it - verified with an expired enterprise user capped at 5.
server.py at 720 lines exceeds the 700-line guideline; refactor into routers.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_razorpay_payments.py (updated stale webhook-200/unauth-status expectations to the new secure behaviour)
/app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_checkers.py (starter-quota test no longer upgrades via the webhook; seeds plan in Mongo instead)

success_rate.backend: 100% (46/47 passed, 1 skipped for exhausted Winston credits, 0 failed)
success_rate.frontend: not tested (backend-only request); Dashboard.jsx copy verified by static assertion only

seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_*@qa-truelense.com users + Razorpay test orders; all deleted afterwards (users, usage, payment_transactions). demo@truelense.app reset to plan='free' with plan_valid_until unset - verified in Mongo.
test_credentials: demo@truelense.app / demo1234 (/app/memory/test_credentials.md; file now correctly lists the Razorpay test card)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -n 0 -q` (serial; shared demo user makes -n>0 racy). Three suites: test_auth_and_checkers.py, test_razorpay_payments.py, test_security_fixes.py. IMPORTANT: never reuse one requests.Session for authed and unauthed assertions (login sets a session_token cookie). The webhook now returns 503 while RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is '' - do NOT use it to simulate upgrades; seed plan/plan_valid_until via mongosh on test_database instead. A locally valid HMAC on /payments/verify no longer upgrades the plan (Razorpay must report the order paid), so real-payment completion still cannot be tested without a card flow. Winston credits ~270 left -> /api/check/text with long text 502s; /api/check/url and qr/image still work. Frontend UI/design was verified in iteration_2 and not re-run here.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_2 root causes (webhook not verifying signature when the secret was empty, and _upgrade_user_for_order trusting the local tx record; plus payment_status having no Depends(require_user)) are all addressed in server.py: the webhook raises 503 before any parsing when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is falsy, _upgrade_user_for_order gates the DB writes on rzp.order.fetch status=='paid' or amount_paid>=amount, payment_status requires the JWT and asserts tx.user_id == caller, and get_usage() drops an expired paid plan to 'free'. All verified live against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
